messages.text: Where is my order? Order #Shop····, email (email hidden)

Neelesh, your B30 is at our Brampton warehouse and set aside for you. It hasn't shipped because the free Power K. on the same order is still waiting on stock, and the warehouse won't send part of a box.

I can split the order so the B30 ships now and the Power K. follows in its own parcel when it arrives. There's no extra cost, and you'd get separate tracking for each. Want me to do that?

You can follow incoming stock here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status
I see the order is ready to dispatch but can you delay shipping my order until Friday November 13, 2026?
Handed to the team · No tool to place a dated shipping hold; needs a person in ShipBob.

I'll leave the order as it is and won't split it, Neelesh. Your B30 is still sitting at Brampton waiting on the Power K., so nothing ships tonight.

I can't set a "don't ship before" date myself, so I've asked the team to hold it until Friday, November 13. They're offline right now and will pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET. You'll get their confirmation by email.

You're welcome, Neelesh. The hold request is with the team, and their confirmation will come to your email.

One quick question before you go, if you don't mind: is the November 13 date about being away, or about having space or power ready for the B30? That helps us plan around buyers like you.
